subtasks: Pick up the two T-shaped blocks, swap their positions, and place them back with the correct orientations.

Place the pink T held by the left gripper in the blue T's original right-side pose, with the stem pointing toward the back-left from the crossbar. Keep the blue T in place. Open both grippers and return both arms home.
Both T blocks are placed. Return both arms to their initial home poses with both grippers fully open, leaving the blocks in place.
